scope: Authenticated native startup: the shell verifies the backend it launched and gives only that origin an HttpOnly desktop session. Not workspace ownership, crash cleanup, portable packaging or installed OS acceptance.
implemented: DesktopLaunchCredential (nexus/core/studio_desktop.py): 32-byte per-launch secret read once from standard input as lowercase hex; never argv, environment, URL, frontend asset or log. Invalid input exits with code 2 without echoing it.

`nexus studio --desktop-launch-stdin` enables GET /api/desktop/handshake, answering a 64-hex challenge with HMAC-SHA256(secret, 'nexus-desktop-launch/v1' | challenge | workspace | port). Workspace and port binding prevents relaying a proof from another instance.

With a launch credential, every /api/ route without its own authentication requires the nexus_desktop_session cookie (HMAC-derived, constant-time compared) on GET, POST and DELETE, at the same gate team mode uses. /api/bootstrap therefore releases the existing CSRF token only to the session holder. A2A, MCP, public shares, OpenClaw, webhooks/gateway, channel events and callbacks keep their own authentication. Static assets stay public, as in team mode.

Native shell (ring HMAC/SystemRandom) writes the secret to the owned child's stdin before taking ownership, polls with a fresh random challenge per attempt (4 KiB body limit, no proxy, no redirects), verifies in constant time, then sets a host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie for 127.0.0.1, confirms it is in the webview store and only then navigates. Any failure stops the owned child and shows the local 'session' or 'readiness' screen.
wry 0.57 cookies_for_url never matches IP hosts (url.domain() is None), so confirmation reads the full webview store and filters by name, value and domain.

rust.scope: Ownership guards plus a cross-language HMAC vector shared with Python; challenge/workspace/port/key binding; derived session never equals the secret.

python_desktop.scope: Strict stdin parsing without echo, shared vector, handshake proof, 401 without/forged cookie on GET/POST/DELETE, CSRF only with session, static shell public, desktop mode without credential unchanged, CLI exit 2 without echo.

native_acceptance.real_sidecar: Real `python -m nexus.cli studio --desktop-launch-stdin` process verified by the compiled Rust probe; wrong workspace, another launch's credential and an unauthenticated Studio rejected; anonymous /api/bootstrap 401 without token; session cookie 200.

simulation.note: 'bootstrap' returns the unauthenticated shape the previous launcher accepted; it is now rejected.

http_regression.scope: Every tests/test_*.py using make_studio_handler, serve_studio or nexus.cli, plus the completion audit.

native_window_drill.platform: macOS aarch64 development binary, real WKWebView, development sidecar wrapper
native_window_drill.result: Shell launched sidecar, handshake verified on first answer, cookie installed and confirmed, full Studio UI loaded: 69 requests all HTTP 200 including /api/bootstrap; outside curl without cookie got 401.
native_window_drill.found_and_fixed: First drill failed closed with 'session' because wry cookies_for_url drops IP-host cookies.
native_window_drill.instrumentation: Drill-only scratchpad sidecar logged request line and status only (no headers); removed after the drill along with the drill-created app data, WebKit and cache folders.
native_window_drill.graceful_quit: not exercised; requires an interactive window close
native_window_drill.abnormal_exit: SIGTERM to the shell left the sidecar running (reparented to PID 1, own process group, still listening). Stopped manually. Belongs to the workspace ownership/crash-cleanup slice.

compatibility: Opt-in. `nexus studio` without --desktop-launch-stdin, browser `nexus desktop launch` and team mode are unchanged. The native shell now requires a sidecar that supports --desktop-launch-stdin; an older bundled sidecar fails closed at the readiness screen. Startup no longer reads /api/bootstrap; the webview UI still does, now with its session cookie. No storage or schema change.
remaining: Native/CLI cross-process workspace ownership; sidecar must not outlive an abnormally terminated shell; interactive close/quit/relaunch drill.
Replace absolute build-machine Python wrappers with a bundled portable runtime containing server UI/assets and dependencies.
Clean macOS/Linux/Windows installed builds, signing, update and permissions acceptance; WebView2 and WebKitGTK cookie behaviour is unverified.
known_limits: Cookies are host-scoped, not port-scoped: another loopback service navigated to inside the same webview would receive the cookie. The shell only navigates to the verified origin; the value is useless against any other launch.
/api/desktop/handshake answers any local caller; a proof is only meaningful to the secret holder and binds challenge, workspace and port.
